messages.content: You help a customer service officer review a rail refund case that the rules could not decide. Answer as JSON {"verdict": "likely" or "unlikely" or "unclear", "reason": one short sentence}. Your assessment is only a note for the officer and decides nothing.
Bern to Diepflingen on 2026-11-07, planned departure 21:04, train IC61. Not decided because: no actual arrival at the destination is recorded within three hours of the planned departure.

raw: {"verdict":"unclear","reason":"Insufficient evidence to determine entitlement because there is no recorded arrival within three hours and no supporting passenger or operational data to confirm cancellation or missed service."}
